newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian PM opens meeting of top security chiefs.
newsitem.headline: Russian PM opens meeting of top security chiefs.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin began a hastily called meeting with his interior and defence ministers and top security officials on Thursday, RIA news agency said.

The meeting was arranged after the political confrontation between security supremo Alexander Lebed and Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov flared into a full-scale war of words. Kulikov accused Lebed of trying to seize power through use of force. Lebed denied the charges.

RIA said the meeting was also attended by President Boris Yeltsin's chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais. The security officials included heads of the Federal Security Service, foreign intelligence service and border troops, said the agency.
It did not name Lebed among those present and his office was not immediately available for comment.

Yeltsin, who is in a sanatorium outside Moscow preparing for open heart surgery due next month, demanded on Wednesday that Chernomyrdin and Kulikov give him all documentation regarding Kulikov's charges.

Yeltsin, who has passed control of "power ministries" to Chernomyrdin while he is away from the Kremlin, was worried about the confrontation between Lebed and Kulikov, the president's press secretary said.
